videos.description: Can Dogecoin or Shiba Inu ever repeat their old rallies? A side by side look at the numbers Both coins had legendary runs in 2021. Looking at the data from September 26 shows how different their situations are today. Size is the first big gap. CoinGecko listed Dogecoin at around 15.2 billion dollars in market cap, good for 12th place, while Shiba Inu stood at roughly 3.5 billion dollars in 34th. That makes Dogecoin a little more than four times bigger. It also reaches more people, with about 8.5 million addresses holding it according to BitInfoCharts, although over a third of them contain only dust. Shiba Inu reported a little over 1.58 million holders back in April 2026. Getting back to the old highs would take a lot. Dogecoin sat roughly 87 percent below its May 2021 peak of 0.73 dollars, so it would need to multiply about seven and a half times. For Shiba Inu the gap was even wider, around 93 percent below its October 2021 record of 0.0000862 dollars, which works out to nearly a fifteenfold climb. The token supply tells another part of the story. New Dogecoin is created every year with no fixed limit, and about 156 billion coins were in circulation. Shiba Inu carries around 589 trillion tokens and dropped about 67 percent in 2025 following the exploit on the Shibarium bridge. Dogecoin's lead comes with caveats. Several of its sharpest moves in the past followed posts from Elon Musk, a reminder of how much the price can hinge on one person. BitInfoCharts also showed the three largest addresses, mainly exchanges and custodians, holding about 31 percent of the supply. Worth noting too that both coins saw their wildest rallies when they were a fraction of today's size. If you had to pick one of the two, which would it be and why? Let us know in the comments. This content is for informational and educational purposes only and is not financial advice. Always do your own research before making any decision. #crypto #shibainu #shib #dogecoin #doge
